title: Strands Agents Hands-On: Build Your First Agent on AWS
description: Join AWS User Group Mysuru for a hands-on technical session on building autonomous AI agents on AWS. In this session, you will explore the core concepts of AI agents and get step-by-step experience constructing your first functional agent on cloud infrastructure.
